row.evidence: Bytebase's pricing page lists "OIDC, LDAP SSO, SCIM, 2FA, audit log" under the Enterprise plan (Contact Us); Community and Pro have no SCIM.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: Community free (up to 20 users), Pro $20/user/month (cancel any time, billing period not stated), Enterprise Contact Us on a yearly subscription. Pro includes only Google/GitHub sign-in (social, not counted as SSO); OIDC/OAuth2/LDAP SSO and SCIM are Enterprise. SCIM is documented for Entra ID (non-gallery app) and Okta (custom app) only; other SCIM clients are untested. The REST API is not plan-gated (Community is enough for the API tutorials).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Google and GitHub sign-in only (social, not SAML/OIDC with the customer's IdP). Audit log 7-day retention. Can be cancelled any time; annual vs monthly billing not stated.

auth.token_source: Settings > Members > Directory Sync (Okta guide); Security & Policy > Users & Groups > Sync From Entra ID (Azure AD) (Entra guide)
auth.notes: Token can be rotated through the API (rotateDirectorySyncToken), which immediately invalidates the previous one. Expiry is not documented.

custom.how: Entra guide adds a custom group attribute 'email' (mapped from mail) to sync the group email.

attributes.notes: Docs only say users sync 'name and email'; exact SCIM attribute paths beyond userName are not listed.

roles.how: SCIM does not sync roles (Role column is ❌ for both IdPs); roles are granted to synced groups inside Bytebase projects.

limitations.text: Only Entra ID and Okta are documented; other SCIM-capable IdPs may work but are untested.
LDAP SSO cannot be combined with SCIM; Entra/Okta must use OIDC or OAuth 2.0 sign-in for SCIM.
The Bytebase External URL must be configured and reachable from the IdP (self-hosted).
Assigning an Okta group provisions its members only; groups must be pushed with Okta Push Groups. Nested groups are not supported.
Only Workspace Admins can configure SCIM.

auth.notes: Service account API key exchanged for access tokens (1 hour by default). Access is governed by Bytebase IAM permissions (e.g. bb.users.list, bb.users.delete), not OAuth scopes. Every endpoint is served by the customer's own Bytebase instance, so there is no fixed base URL.

capabilities.notes: DeleteUser is reversible via UndeleteUser, so it behaves as a deactivate. CreateUser is self-hosted only; in SaaS mode users are added through the workspace IAM policy.

endpoints.purpose: Set workspace IAM policy (grant workspace roles)
Rotate the SCIM directory sync token

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks are project-level and cover issue and pipeline events only.

limitations.text: CreateUser works only on self-hosted; in SaaS mode admins add users via workspace IAM policy.

okta.notes: Bytebase's guide has admins build their own SWA app and switch provisioning to SCIM; no OIN catalogue app found (okta.com/integrations/bytebase/ returns 404).

entra.notes: Bytebase's guide uses a non-gallery enterprise app.

jumpcloud.notes: Bytebase's SSO overview lists JumpCloud via LDAP with no SCIM guide.

fallbacks.notes: JIT applies to SSO sign-in (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, LDAP).

citations.title: Okta - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)
citations.quote: Navigate to Settings -> Members. Click the Directory Sync button (or gear icon).

citations.title: Okta - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)

citations.title: Okta - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)

citations.title: Entra ID - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)
citations.quote: Select Create your own application. Give your application a descriptive name, and select Integrate any other application you don't find in the gallery (Non-gallery) option, then click Create.

citations.title: Entra ID - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)
citations.quote: Bytebase uses the group's externalId to uniquely identify a group. By default, Entra ID maps objectId to externalId, which is stable and recommended. You can optionally add a custom email attribute to sync the group email to Bytebase.

citations.title: Entra ID - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)
citations.quote: Click Sync From Entra ID (Azure AD).

citations.title: Entra ID - Bytebase Docs (SCIM)
citations.quote: Bytebase endpoint implements SCIM protocol, please make sure you have configured External URL and it's network accessible from Entra.

citations.title: SSO Overview - Bytebase Docs

citations.title: SSO Overview - Bytebase Docs
citations.quote: Bytebase implements standard SCIM 2.0, so other cloud IdPs that can push SCIM over HTTP may work but are untested.

citations.title: SSO Overview - Bytebase Docs
citations.quote: Bytebase employs JIT (Just-In-Time) user provisioning. It will create the user the first time the user signs in.

citations.title: Audit Log - Bytebase Docs
